summary.en: Canvas recording, format negotiation, and Blob downloads.
summary.zh: 画布录制、格式协商和 Blob 下载。

description.en: Select the first supported recording MIME type, without starting capture.
description.zh: 选取首个受支持的录制 MIME 类型，不会启动捕获。

description.en: Supported MIME string; null if MediaRecorder is absent or none of the candidates is supported.
description.zh: 返回支持的 MIME 字符串；若不存在 MediaRecorder 或候选格式都不支持则返回 null。

constraints.en: Actual 2.0.0 order: video/webm;codecs=vp9 → video/webm;codecs=vp8 → video/webm → video/mp4;codecs=avc1.42E01E → video/mp4. The declaration comment suggesting MP4 first is stale.
constraints.zh: 2.0.0 实际顺序：video/webm;codecs=vp9 → video/webm;codecs=vp8 → video/webm → video/mp4;codecs=avc1.42E01E → video/mp4。声明中 MP4 优先的注释已过时。

constraints.en: isTypeSupported is capability negotiation, not a guarantee that a recording will produce bytes.
constraints.zh: isTypeSupported 只是能力协商，并不保证录制一定能产出数据。

description.en: Records a canvas video stream through the browser MediaRecorder API.
description.zh: 通过浏览器 MediaRecorder API 录制画布视频流。

description.en: Negotiate and retain the preferred MIME type.
description.zh: 协商并保存首选 MIME 格式。

description.en: An idle recorder; capture has not started.
description.zh: 空闲录制器，尚未开始捕获。

errors.en: Throws Error('MediaRecorder is not supported in this environment') when pickMime() returns null.
errors.zh: pickMime() 返回 null 时抛出 Error('MediaRecorder is not supported in this environment')。

description.en: Chosen MIME type, fixed at construction.
description.zh: 构造时选定的 MIME 类型。

description.en: Selected codec/container string.
description.zh: 选中的编码器/容器字符串。

description.en: Whether the underlying recorder is currently in state recording.
description.zh: 底层录制器当前状态是否为 recording。

description.en: False before start and after stop; true while recording.
description.zh: 启动前和停止后为 false，录制中为 true。

description.en: Begin capturing a canvas at a requested 60 frames per second.
description.zh: 以请求的 60 帧/秒开始捕获画布。

description.en: Canvas to record; its changing pixels become the video. No audio track is added.
description.zh: 待录制的画布；其像素变化构成视频，不添加音轨。

description.en: Requested video bitrate in bits/second; the browser may choose the actual bitrate.
description.zh: 请求的视频比特率，单位比特/秒；实际码率由浏览器决定。

description.en: No return value.
description.zh: 无返回值。

constraints.en: Uses canvas.captureStream(60), MediaRecorder.start(250), and collects nonempty data chunks. It does not advance or redraw the canvas.
constraints.zh: 调用 canvas.captureStream(60)、MediaRecorder.start(250)，收集非空数据块；不会推进模拟或重绘画布。

constraints.en: Wait for the previous stop() promise before starting again. The recorder reference remains set until the stop event.
constraints.zh: 再次开始前等待上次 stop() Promise 完成；stop 事件之前内部仍保留录制器引用。

errors.en: Throws Error('Recording already in progress') if an internal recorder exists. Browser captureStream/MediaRecorder errors also propagate, including an origin-tainted canvas or unsupported encoder.
errors.zh: 已有内部录制器时抛出 Error('Recording already in progress')；浏览器 captureStream/MediaRecorder 错误也会直接传播，例如画布被跨域内容污染或编码器不可用。

description.en: Stop recording and join collected video chunks into a Blob.
description.zh: 结束录制，并将收集的视频块合并为 Blob。

description.en: Resolves after the MediaRecorder stop event with the recording data and elapsed wall-clock duration.
description.zh: MediaRecorder stop 事件后返回录制数据和经过的墙钟时间。

errors.en: Rejects Error('没有进行中的录制') if no recorder is recording, and rejects if the final Blob has zero bytes. Native stop errors may reject too.
errors.zh: 没有正在录制的实例时拒绝并返回 Error('没有进行中的录制')；最终 Blob 为 0 字节时也拒绝。原生 stop 错误也可能导致拒绝。

constraints.en: No MediaRecorder error listener, cancellation, or explicit stream-track cleanup is exposed. Call stop once per started session and handle rejection.
constraints.zh: 没有暴露 MediaRecorder 错误监听器、取消或显式视频轨道清理功能。每次启动后只调用一次 stop，并处理拒绝。

caption.en: Start capture and save it from a later stop action.
caption.zh: 开始捕获，并由后续停止操作保存视频。

exports.name: RecordingResult
exports.signature: interface RecordingResult { blob: Blob; mimeType: string; seconds: number; bytes: number; }

description.en: Metadata and bytes returned by CanvasRecorder.stop().
description.zh: CanvasRecorder.stop() 返回的数据和元信息。

description.en: Recorded video chunks combined into one Blob.
description.zh: 合并后的视频 Blob。

description.en: MIME selected by the recorder.
description.zh: 录制器选中的 MIME。

description.en: Elapsed performance.now() time from start to stop event, in seconds; not measured media timeline duration.
description.zh: 从 start 到 stop 事件的 performance.now() 时间差，单位秒；不是解析媒体轨道得出的时长。

description.en: Blob.size in bytes.
description.zh: Blob.size，单位字节。

description.en: Ask the browser to download a Blob using an object URL.
description.zh: 使用对象 URL 请求浏览器下载 Blob。

description.en: Data to download.
description.zh: 待下载的数据。

description.en: Suggested download filename; browser policies may alter it.
description.zh: 建议下载文件名，浏览器策略可能修改它。

description.en: No return value.
description.zh: 无返回值。

constraints.en: Requires a browser document. Creates and clicks an anchor, then revokes the object URL after 5000 ms. This is a download request, not a completion receipt.
constraints.zh: 需要浏览器 document；创建并点击链接，5000 ms 后释放对象 URL。此操作只是发起下载，不代表下载已完成。

examples.code:
import { downloadBlob } from 'wgpu-kit/media';
downloadBlob(new Blob(['hello'], { type: 'text/plain' }), 'hello.txt');
